    Edge(int s, int d, lli cap, lli w) : src(s), dst(d), capacity(cap), weight(w), flow(0) {}

void add_edge(int u, int v, lli cap, lli wgt) {

    adj[v].emplace_back(edge_list.size());
    edge_list.emplace_back(v, u, 0, -wgt);

void bellman_ford(int source, int nodes) {
    fill(pot, pot + MAX_NODES, INF);
    pot[source] = 0;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < nodes; ++iter) {
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < edge_list.size(); ++idx) {

            if (pot[e.src] == INF) continue;
